name: retire-2041
notes: Retirement of capital hulls (user, 2026-10-23): with the alien exotics stock at 0, the oldest capital hulls are retired until ship upkeep fits the drip left after the terminus and base upkeep. A year from the 15-year campaign's final save (stock 1,972 falling ~100/month, so it reaches 0 within the year), strategist off for speed. Run: tools/run.ps1 -Probe retire-2041 -SavePath lab/results/20261022-232243-campaign-2026-15y/final.gz -Days 540. v2: the stock is set to 0 at the start (the 540-day run ended with it at 518, still ~5 months from 0), so retirement must fire at the first monthly economy tick; 150 days. v3: retire to 85% of the fit (RetireMargin) and refuse new FoundBase goals while short (NoBasesWhenShort): in v2 five new bases (four at Io, scripted, imp 19) took back the freed upkeep and retirements went on monthly. v4: the slack counts the terminus draw; bases refused while short. Result: one retirement (132 hulls), none after, bases held at 19, upkeep 48 fits drip 71 minus terminus 21; the stock hovers near 0 (the ~2/month surplus goes to ship builds and repairs). v5 (user, 2026-10-23): at most 10% of the capital hulls held are retired per month (RetireMaxShare), so the cut is spread over about a year and a half; 540 days.
asserts: all(e['count'] <= e['cap'] for e in events('retire'))
info: [(e['t'][:7], e['count'], e['cap'], e['capitalHulls'], round(e['saved'], 1), round(e['excess'], 1)) for e in events('retire')]
[(e['t'][:7], e['stock']['Exotics'], round(e['drip'], 1), e['upkeep'], e['shipUpkeep'], e['bases']) for e in events('economy')][::2]
[(e['t'], e['n'], e['target'], e['imp']) for e in events('base-refused')][:10]
[(r['t'][:7], round(faction(r, 'AlienCouncil').get('scv', 0)), faction(r, 'AlienCouncil').get('ships'), faction(r, 'AlienCouncil').get('bases')) for r in metrics]
[(e['t'], e['ev'], e.get('why'), round(e.get('after', 0), 3), round(e.get('invest', 0), 1)) for e in events('terminus')][::3]
[(e['t'], e['fleet'], e['at'], e['ships'], e['dry'], e['dvBefore'], e['dvAfter'], e.get('goal')) for e in events('dry-split')]
[(e['t'][:7], e['targetSystem'], round(e['need']), round(e['have']), [(d['fleet'], round(d['scv']), d.get('was')) for d in e['donors']]) for e in events('pool') if e['donors']]
sum(1 for e in events('pool') for d in e['donors'] if d.get('was') == 'SendFleet')
[(e['t'][:7], e['targetSystem'], round(e['have']), round(e['need'])) for e in events('pool-muster')]
[(r['t'][:7], r['fleet'], round(r['scv']), r['toSystem'], r.get('targetFaction')) for r in events('transfer', goal='AttackWithFleet') if r['scv'] > 1000]
(count('combat', attacker='AlienCouncil', occurred=True), count('combat', attacker='AlienCouncil', occurred=True, winner='AlienCouncil'))
